item.tib: rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab kyi skyes rabs rnam bshad nor bu'i phreng ba yis ngor g.yo ma 'jigs skyobs g.yung drung go cha
item.coloph: de ltar bdag cag gi ston pa dgra bcom rgyal ba gshen rab de nyid grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gis mthar thug mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ bcu gnyis mdzad chen yongs dang rgyal bstan byung tshul gyi legs par bshad pas brgyan pa rtogs brjod rin po che 'di nyid/ sprod thub kyi thos bsam cher med na'ang / 'khrungs rabs zhal skyin tsam las don bshad rgyas bsdus snga phyi'i mkhas grub rnams kyis bsgrig rgyu ma byung ba/ de phyir chos brgyad mkhas grags kyis bsgrigs pa min zhing / rgyal bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan dang / de 'dzin mkhas grub che rigs kyi mkhyen ngor gsal bzhin slar gsal gdab dang / ranga'adra'i blo dman rnams yid la nges shes bskyed pa'i ched du/ dang po thugs bskyed tshul dang / grangs med nges don du byas pa'i skor rnams kun grol rin po che'i bstod phyag 'grel dang*/ mdzad bcu'i rnam bshad gtso bor bzhag nas bkod/ grangs can gyi skyes rabs rnams/ mdo rgyud kun nas 'khrungs rabs mthong thos rnams bsdus nas/ rnam bshad nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bgyi ba glegs bam gcig tu dril ba 'di/ gnam skos gong ma'i lung gis bsngags pa'i sa dbang sde dge rgyal po'i mnga' ris bu 'bor dbyibs klung du dal rten rnyed pa/ sngon bsags dkar po'i 'phro yis smon rgyal pad ma rgyal po'i yang srid du khas 'che ba/ ming tsam ma yin pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i g.yung drung slob dpon du ma'i zhabs bsnyegs pa'i/ sum ldan gyi khul 'dzin pa'i gyi na pa g.yung drung bstan pa dbang rgyal du 'bod pas/ ston mchog khri gtsug rgyal ba'i sku dang gsung bstan nyi khri rdzogs shing thugs bstan khri las nyis stong bdun brgya re bzhi 'das pa'i mtshams/ legs sbyar saMskr-i ta'i skad du sarba (?)stod 'grel las bod skad du bsgyar ba kun 'dzin/ stong kun rgyal po'i khabs su wu tsi/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming sa pho byi ba'i lor/ tha skar zla ba'i tshos rdzogs pa dang po/ res bza' lhag pa/ rgyu skar lha mtshams la spyod pa'i 'grub sbyor nyin du dbu gtsugs nas brtsam ste/ mgo zla'i grub pa'i nyi mar mjug phyung ba yan/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal kun grol grags kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag gshen bstan rin po che phyogs brgyar kun du dar zhing yun ring du gnas nas/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
